steps.sql: SELECT c.name, STUFF((SELECT ', ' + o.item FROM dbo.ord o WHERE o.cust_id = c.id ORDER BY o.id FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS items FROM dbo.cust c ORDER BY c.id

SELECT c.id AS [@id], c.name AS [name], (SELECT o.id AS [@id], o.item AS [item], o.qty AS [qty] FROM dbo.ord o WHERE o.cust_id = c.id ORDER BY o.id FOR XML PATH('order'), TYPE) AS [orders] FROM dbo.cust c ORDER BY c.id FOR XML PATH('customer'), ROOT('customers')
SELECT c.id, c.name, o.id, o.item FROM dbo.cust c LEFT JOIN dbo.ord o ON o.cust_id = c.id ORDER BY c.id, o.id FOR XML AUTO
SELECT cust.id, cust.name, ord.item, ord.qty FROM dbo.cust cust JOIN dbo.ord ord ON ord.cust_id = cust.id ORDER BY cust.id, ord.id FOR XML AUTO, ELEMENTS, ROOT('r')
SELECT * FROM dbo.ord ORDER BY id FOR XML RAW('o'), ELEMENTS XSINIL, ROOT('orders')
SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(qty) AS total FROM dbo.ord GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY cust_id FOR XML PATH('c')

DECLARE @doc xml = (SELECT id AS [@id], item FROM dbo.ord ORDER BY id FOR XML PATH('o'), ROOT('all'), TYPE);
SELECT x.o.value('@id', 'int') AS id, x.o.value('(item/text())[1]', 'nvarchar(20)') AS item, x.o.exist('item') AS has_item FROM @doc.nodes('/all/o') x(o) ORDER BY id

DECLARE @doc xml = N'<ids><id>11</id><id>13</id><id>99</id></ids>';
SELECT o.id, o.item FROM dbo.ord o JOIN @doc.nodes('/ids/id') t(n) ON o.id = t.n.value('.', 'int') ORDER BY o.id

DECLARE @doc xml = N'<ids><id>11</id><id>13</id></ids>';
SELECT id FROM dbo.ord WHERE id IN (SELECT t.n.value('.', 'int') FROM @doc.nodes('/ids/id') t(n)) ORDER BY id
SELECT d.id FROM (VALUES (1, CAST(N'<a k="x"/>' AS xml)), (2, CAST(N'<a k="y"/>' AS xml))) d(id, doc) WHERE d.doc.exist('/a[@k="y"]') = 1
DECLARE @k nvarchar(5) = N'y'; SELECT d.id FROM (VALUES (1, CAST(N'<a k="x"/>' AS xml)), (2, CAST(N'<a k="y"/>' AS xml))) d(id, doc) WHERE d.doc.exist('/a[@k=sql:variable("@k")]') = 1

SELECT o.id, d.doc.value('(/a/@k)[1]', 'nvarchar(5)') AS k FROM dbo.ord o CROSS APPLY (SELECT CAST(N'<a k="' + CAST(o.qty AS nvarchar(5)) + N'"/>' AS xml) AS doc) d WHERE d.doc.value('(/a/@k)[1]', 'int') > 2 ORDER BY o.id
SELECT ' ' + item FROM dbo.ord WHERE item IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id FOR XML PATH('')
SELECT (SELECT ' ' FOR XML PATH('')) AS a, (SELECT ' ' AS [text()] FOR XML PATH('')) AS b, (SELECT N' x ' FOR XML PATH('')) AS c
SELECT 1 AS a, NULL AS b FOR XML PATH(''), ELEMENTS XSINIL
SELECT 1 AS a, NULL AS b FOR XML PATH(''), ELEMENTS XSINIL, ROOT('r')
SELECT id, (SELECT qty FROM dbo.ord i WHERE i.id = o.id FOR XML RAW, TYPE) AS x FROM dbo.ord o ORDER BY id FOR XML RAW, ELEMENTS
CREATE VIEW dbo.v_items AS SELECT c.id, (SELECT o.item + ';' FROM dbo.ord o WHERE o.cust_id = c.id ORDER BY o.id FOR XML PATH('')) AS items FROM dbo.cust c
SELECT id, items FROM dbo.v_items ORDER BY id
WITH x AS (SELECT (SELECT id AS [@id] FROM dbo.ord ORDER BY id FOR XML PATH('o'), TYPE) AS doc) SELECT n.o.value('@id', 'int') AS id FROM x CROSS APPLY x.doc.nodes('/o') n(o) ORDER BY id
SELECT REPLICATE(CAST(N'ab' AS nvarchar(max)), 1100) + NCHAR(55357) + NCHAR(56838) AS a FOR XML PATH('')

DECLARE @x xml = N'<r><i n="1"/><i n="2"/><i n="3"/></r>'; SELECT n.i.value('@n', 'int') AS n, n.i.value('count(../i)', 'int') AS c, n.i.value('local-name(..)', 'varchar(5)') AS p FROM @x.nodes('/r/i') n(i)
DECLARE @x xml = N'<r><i n="1"/><i n="2"/><i n="3"/></r>'; SELECT n.i.value('@n', 'int') AS n FROM @x.nodes('/r/i[@n >= 2]') n(i) ORDER BY n DESC
DECLARE @x xml = N'a'; SELECT @x.value('(/r/i/@n)[1]', 'nvarchar(10)') + @x.value('(/r/i)[1]', 'nvarchar(10)') AS v, LEN(@x.value('(/r/i)[1]', 'nvarchar(10)')) AS l, CAST(@x AS nvarchar(max)) AS t
DECLARE @x xml = N'<r/>'; SELECT @x.query('/r') AS a, @x.query('/r/*') AS b, @x.value('string(/r[1])', 'nvarchar(5)') AS c, @x.exist('/') AS d
DECLARE @x xml; SET @x = (SELECT TOP 2 id, item FROM dbo.ord ORDER BY id FOR XML RAW, TYPE); SELECT @x AS x; SET @x = NULL; SELECT @x AS y, CAST(@x AS nvarchar(10)) AS z
DECLARE @t TABLE (d xml); INSERT @t SELECT (SELECT id FROM dbo.ord ORDER BY id FOR XML PATH, TYPE); SELECT d FROM @t
SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar(max), (SELECT id, item FROM dbo.ord ORDER BY id FOR XML PATH('o'), TYPE)) AS t, CAST((SELECT item FROM dbo.ord ORDER BY id FOR XML PATH('')) AS xml) AS x
